(2) The scene shifts to a medical treatment room. A patient lies horizontally with protective goggles over their eyes. A medical practitioner's gloved hands apply a handheld device emitting bright purple light flashes to the patient's face. The environment is sterile and professional. (3) Cut back to the female doctor in the office. She uses her hand to frame her jawline, demonstrating a lifting effect. The lighting is even and soft. (6) A different medical device, black and blocky, is used on a patient's cheek, appearing to create a suction effect. The patient's eyes are closed and they remain still. (7) Final frame displays a white background with a grey logo, social media handles, and contact phone numbers listed clearly in the center.
